description: Create a checklist (a named group of sub-items) on a task. Returns the created checklist with its id. Use to add a structured to-do list inside a task, then add items with `create_checklist_item`.

custom_task_ids.description: Set true when `task_id` is a custom task ID instead of a native ClickUp ID. Requires `team_id`.

task_id.description: ID of the task to add the checklist to.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: create_checklist
